answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can run a Juniper Grove audit lottery: every agent stakes 2,000 POA into a shared oasis pool, and each epoch a random draw picks 5% of agents for a live pulse check. A picked agent has 10 minutes to finish a fresh task proving control of its hardware key, renewed quarterly. Missing or failing slashes half its stake and freezes it 3 epochs. Faking 1,000 agents then costs 2,000,000 POA plus 1,000 attestations at $40 each, with half at risk each epoch. Like an oasis that only opens to travelers who prove they crossed the dunes, a mirage cannot drink.
